title: Replication package for "Latency optimization and oracle-based failure diagnosis in interactive adaptive learning pipelines"
description:
Reference implementation, benchmark harness and complete measurement scripts for an oracle-localised measurement study of the recommendation critical path of Coglica, a research platform for game-based cognitive assessment.

The package reproduces every table and figure in the accompanying article: the oracle substitution that localises the lost value to the predictor rather than to the architecture; the sweep of the two interacting configuration choices inside the predictor; the latency decomposition and the cost model fitted under four serving runtimes; the closed-form enumeration/search crossover and its validation; the comparison of search strategies including stronger model-based baselines; the concurrency sweep against the synchronous and asynchronous deadlines; and the degradation chain measured in a domain metric rather than as an availability rate.

No human-subject data are used. Every domain-metric result is a simulation against a reconstructed response model; see README.md for the reconstruction's fidelity checks and limitations.
